operator_request: 17.10.2026 D: continue independent L1 book qualification and masks before P0; existing 26 months only.
source_fields: All 20 fields in the existing CSV, including BBO, counts, depth and ts_in_delta
duplicate_rule: Compare all 20 fields for each existing consecutive T signature suspect, including batch seams. Preserve existing trade masks regardless of collision count.

mask_rules.snapshot_observation: At least one clean F_LAST BBO observation, no aggressor requirement; this is not a continuous integral.
mask_rules.clean_minute: positive records and clean F_LAST BBO; reject any invalid/crossed/locked/undefined/off-tick/empty BBO, gap flag, bad receive flag, snapshot, R reset, repeated T signature or first-file record.
mask_rules.continuous_candidates: clean current minute and clean immediately prior eligible minute, same selected contract; no bridge across invalid minute, file seam or contract roll. Separate OFI and time-integral mask columns. Candidate inputs only, not computed/qualified features.
mask_rules.M5: all five actual native M1 coordinates, same selected contract; own-family masks, never require known aggressor side for BBO/OFI
